title: UserStory
description: A user story representing a feature or requirement from the perspective of an end user

id.description: Unique identifier for the user story

title.description: Short title summarizing the user story (As a... I want... So that...)

description.description: Full user story narrative including role, goal, and benefit

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the user story

priority.description: Priority level of the user story

acceptanceCriteria.description: List of acceptance criteria that define done for this story

tags.description: Labels or tags associated with the story

assignee.description: Username or ID of the person assigned to this story

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user story was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user story was last updated
